task.description:
REWORK 1/3 - Fix these MAJOR issues from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR:

1. MAJOR: Missing error taxonomy section (Linter E010)
   Location: src/design/definition-leak-fix.md line ~119
   Problem: Section titled Error handling but linter expects error taxonomy, errors, or error cases
   Fix: Rename section header to match expected naming convention

2. MAJOR: Implementation code present
   Location: Public interface additions and Changes to existing cleanup functions sections
   Problem: Contains complete function body implementations for Definition.deinit(), DefinitionGraph.deinit(), freeDefinitionGraph(), freeDefinition()
   Fix: Replace function bodies with prose descriptions of behavior. Type E prose designs document interfaces but not implementations.

---

WF-03 Step 2: Fix Design for ISS-0601-LEAK-001

Create a design artefact for the memory leak fix in src/definition/store.zig parseGraphJson.

Input: docs/issue-reports/ISS-0601-LEAK-001-diagnosis.yaml (recommends Strategy 1: add Definition.deinit())

This is a Type E (novel/cross-cutting) fix per templates/lego-catalog.md because:
- Requires adding a new method to Definition struct
- Must update 100+ call sites across the codebase
- Affects multiple modules (api/routes, tests, engine)

Write design to: src/design/definition-leak-fix.md

Design must include:
1. New Definition.deinit(allocator) method signature
2. What it frees: all graph_json-allocated strings (node.id, node.label, edge.id, etc.)
3. Which files need changes: src/definition/graph.zig, all load sites
4. Migration strategy for existing call sites: add defer def.deinit(allocator)
5. Error handling: none needed (deinit is infallible)
6. Testing approach: verify leak-check passes in iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig

Do NOT write implementation code. Only design.

Return PASS with design file in artifacts_out.
acceptance_criteria: Design lists all call sites that need defer statements
Design is pure prose - no implementation code

result.summary: Fixed 2 MAJOR issues in definition-leak-fix.md: (1) renamed Error handling to Error taxonomy per linter E010, (2) replaced implementation code with prose descriptions
